subject: Onboarding: escrow pin + telemetry & rollback agreement for BrightShop integration
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, BrightShop Sales <brightshop-sales@brightshop.com>
Cc: BrightShop Legal <legal@brightshop.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding: escrow pin + telemetry & rollback agreement for BrightShop integration

Hi all —

Thanks for the productive kickoff yesterday. BrightShop will start integration tests next week and asked for a short-term version lock (escrow) while they validate behavior against their workload. Before we commit, I want to align internal owners and get a concise list of constraints we can share with their engineers and legal.

Proposal (high level):
- Temporary escrow (model version pin) for 4 weeks during initial integration; allow roll-forward only after telemetry OK.
- Canary: 100 qps ramped over 72 hours, with fallback to a pinned compatible variant if errors > 1% or latency P95 > 800ms.
- Telemetry contract: request the following metrics (latency P50/P95, error rate, token distribution, OOV rate) and 30-day retention for debug traces.
- Security: BrightShop asked for data retention language — we cannot enable prefix caching for requests labeled PII; need a legal sign-off and a config path.

Attachments: redwood-integration-plan-v1.pdf, telemetry-spec.xlsx (draft).

Can Karthik and Priyom confirm runtime compatibility concerns (tokenizer parity, KV cache interactions, quantization variants) and propose the exact model tags we should pin? Laura, can you confirm sequencing for Dedicated capacity / canary window and who owns the customer-facing comms?

Jonas
Director, Product Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: BrightShop Sales <brightshop-sales@brightshop.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightShop Legal <legal@brightshop.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: escrow pin + telemetry & rollback agreement for BrightShop integration

Jonas —

Appreciate the clear plan. Legal flagged two items they need in writing before the escrow: 1) explicit data retention & deletion commitments for logs and telemetry, and 2) confirmation that model caching will not persist customer inputs marked as PII. I've attached our security checklist for reference.

From an integration perspective, our engineers are fine with a 4-week pin but would like a documented rollback playbook (steps if we detect drift in hallucination rate). Could you include a short runbook we can reference?

Thanks,
Sara Li
Technical Partnerships
BrightShop

Attachment: BrightShop-Security-Checklist.pdf

Thanks, Jonas. Quick notes from product/ops:
- I'll own customer-facing comms and the rollout calendar. Propose canary start Mon 2025-08-25 08:00 PT, ramp plan attached in the integration plan.
- We'll provision a small Dedicated pool for the canary (2x A100 equivalent) to isolate traffic — Priyom, can you confirm cost center/charge code and whether the customer will consume any Dedicated ops time?
- Runbook: I will draft a 6-step rollback playbook (quarantine traffic, switch to fallback variant, revoke pins, postmortem). Will share by EOD 8/20.

Laura

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, BrightShop Legal <legal@brightshop.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 13:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: escrow pin + telemetry & rollback agreement for BrightShop integration

Looping in the technical compatibility checks. Summary of key runtime concerns:
- Tokenizer parity: BrightShop uses a custom pre-tokenization pipeline that can change whitespace handling. We need a sample corpus to validate tokenization alignment.
- KV cache semantics: if BrightShop plans to stream long context, we should confirm their expected max context length and whether we should enable cross-request KV reuse. For escrow, prefer to disable cross-customer prefix caching by default.
- Quantization / variants: the serving runtime will prefer the quantized 8-bit variant for cost. We'll pin the canonical model tag 'saturnx-1.2.0' for the escrow window and stage a compatible fallback 'saturnx-1.1.5-compat' that preserves tokenizer and logits parity. If we later need to roll-forward to 1.2.1 we must run the regression suite against BrightShop prompt set.

I've attached a compact compat-matrix.csv and a short checklist for the regression run. My ask: BrightShop team can provide a 2k-sample set for tokenizer parity and a set of 200 critical prompts for the regression suite.

Karthik
Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime

Thanks everyone — good progress. Action items summarized:
1) Karthik: confirm exact model tag to pin (proposed: saturnx-1.2.0) and share compat-matrix.csv (done). Run regression against customer prompts once provided (due 8/22).
2) Laura: publish rollback playbook by EOD 8/20 and confirm canary start (proposed 08/25).
3) Priyom: confirm Dedicated cost center/charge code and any ops windows (please cc billing).
4) BrightShop: provide tokenization sample corpus (2k items) and 200 critical prompts; confirm security checklist items — specifically how you mark PII in requests.
5) Legal / BrightShop Legal: we'll draft a short appendix describing telemetry retention and no-prefix-caching-for-PII; I'll send the first draft by 8/20.

I'll open the temporary escrow request in the model-intake system once Karthik confirms the tag. HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deals/BR-9234 — I'll update status and timeline there.

Jonas
